parameters.query:
WITH q AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (m.from_numero) m.id, m.from_numero, m.content, m.created_at
  FROM giulia_memoria m
  JOIN giulia_donos d ON d.numero = m.from_numero
  WHERE m.role = 'assistant'
    AND COALESCE(d.status, 'ativo') = 'ativo'
    AND d.numero <> '5511910441709'
    AND COALESCE(m.metadata->>'followup', '') = ''
    AND m.content !~ '^(Bom dia|Boa tarde|Boa noite|Lembrete|[*]Fechamento|[*]Relatorio|📧|⚠️|📄|🎂|Montando|Gerando)'
    AND m.created_at > (NOW() AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') - INTERVAL '20 hours'
  ORDER BY m.from_numero, m.id DESC
)
SELECT q.id AS pergunta_id, q.from_numero, q.content AS pergunta, q.created_at,
  ROUND(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM ((NOW() AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') - q.created_at)) / 60)::int AS minutos,
  d.nome, COALESCE(d.idioma, 'pt-BR') AS idioma, d.timezone,
  (SELECT json_agg(x ORDER BY x.id) FROM (SELECT id, role, left(content, 700) AS content FROM giulia_memoria
     WHERE from_numero = q.from_numero AND COALESCE(metadata->>'followup', '') = '' ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 14) x) AS historico,
  (SELECT json_agg(json_build_object('rascunho', p.id, 'resumo', left(p.resumo_texto, 1500), 'faltando', p.faltando, 'pedido', p.pedido))
     FROM hz_invoices_pendentes p WHERE p.dono_numero = q.from_numero AND p.invoice_id IS NULL
     AND p.status NOT IN ('substituido', 'cancelado', 'processado', 'expirado') AND p.expira_em > NOW()) AS invoices_abertas,
  (SELECT json_agg(json_build_object('numero', h.numero, 'cliente', h.cliente->>'nome', 'cidade', h.entrega->>'cidade',
       'endereco', h.entrega->>'endereco', 'acabamentos', (SELECT string_agg(DISTINCT i->>'acabamento', ', ') FROM jsonb_array_elements(h.itens) i)))
     FROM (SELECT * FROM hz_invoices WHERE solicitante_numero = q.from_numero AND NOT teste ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 5) h) AS invoices_anteriores,
  (SELECT string_agg(c.produto || ' (' || c.tams || ')', '; ' ORDER BY c.produto) FROM (SELECT produto, COALESCE(string_agg(DISTINCT tamanho, '/'), 'tamanho unico') AS tams
     FROM hz_catalogo WHERE ativo GROUP BY produto) c
     WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hz_invoices_pendentes p WHERE p.dono_numero = q.from_numero AND p.expira_em > NOW())) AS catalogo_tamanhos
FROM q
JOIN giulia_donos d ON d.numero = q.from_numero
WHERE q.content LIKE '%?%'
  AND q.created_at < (NOW() AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') - INTERVAL '40 minutes'
  AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM giulia_memoria u WHERE u.from_numero = q.from_numero AND u.id > q.id AND u.role = 'user')
  AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM giulia_memoria f WHERE f.from_numero = q.from_numero AND f.id > q.id AND f.metadata->>'followup' = 'true')
  AND to_char(NOW() AT TIME ZONE d.timezone, 'HH24')::int BETWEEN 8 AND 20

WITH alvo AS (
  SELECT f.id, f.from_numero, f.content, d.nome
  FROM giulia_memoria f
  JOIN giulia_donos d ON d.numero = f.from_numero
  WHERE f.metadata->>'followup' = 'true'
    AND COALESCE(f.metadata->>'escalado', '') = ''
    AND f.created_at < (NOW() AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') - INTERVAL '3 hours'
    AND f.created_at > (NOW() AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') - INTERVAL '30 hours'
    AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM giulia_memoria u WHERE u.from_numero = f.from_numero AND u.id > f.id AND u.role = 'user')
    AND to_char(NOW() AT TIME ZONE 'America/Sao_Paulo', 'HH24')::int BETWEEN 8 AND 21
), marca AS (
  UPDATE giulia_memoria m SET metadata = m.metadata || '{"escalado": true}'::jsonb
  FROM alvo WHERE m.id = alvo.id RETURNING m.id
)
INSERT INTO giulia_mensagens_agendadas (destinatario_numero, destinatario_nome, conteudo, agendado_para, status)
SELECT '5511910441709', 'Thiago',
  '⏳ ' || alvo.nome || ' nao respondeu ha mais de 3h, nem depois que eu voltei a perguntar. O que ficou parado: ' ||
  left(regexp_replace(alvo.content, '\s+', ' ', 'g'), 400) || ' - vale um toque seu.',
  NOW() AT TIME ZONE 'America/Sao_Paulo', 'pendente'
FROM alvo
WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM marca WHERE marca.id = alvo.id)
RETURNING id;
